Name: Kenneth's Custom Shops - Fast Build Patches (3 Days)
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b][b]Kenneth's Custom Shops - Fast Build Patches (3 Days)[/b][/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Tired of waiting 30 in-game days for each shop to build?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]If you have all 8 of my shops installed, that's 240 days = almost 2 years in-game![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This is a collection of fast build patches that reduces construction time from [b]30 days -> 3 days[/b].[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]FEATURES:[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Reduces build time from 30 days to 3 days[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- 8 separate patches in one page[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Each patch is just a content.json file[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Lightweight and safe[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]INCLUDED PATCHES (8 Total):[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Kenneth's Bakery - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Kenneth's Dessert Shop - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Kenneth's Drink Shop - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Kenneth's Fruit Shop - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]5. Kenneth's Grocery Store - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]6. Kenneth's Restaurant - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]7. Kenneth's Seed Shop - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]8. Kenneth's Vegetable Shop - Fast Build Patch[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]You can apply all 8 patches if you have all 8 shops (just overwrite each shop's folder), or just the ones you use.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]Example: If you only use Kenneth's Bakery and Kenneth's Seed Shop, just overwrite those 2 shops with their fast build patches.[/size][/b]

[size=4][b][b]REQUIREMENTS:[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Original shop mod(s) from my profile is REQUIRED[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- This patch alone does nothing without the original mod[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]

[b][size=4]INSTALLATION:[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]1. Install the original shop mod (e.g. Kenneth's Bakery) into your Mods folder.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]2. Download the corresponding Fast Build Patch for that shop from the Files tab.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]3. Extract the zip - you'll get a folder like Kenneth's Bakery with content.json inside.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]4. Drag that folder into your Mods folder and choose OVERWRITE / Replace. Only the content.json will be replaced (30 days -> 3 days), your other files like assets, manifest.json, i18n, etc will stay.[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]5. Done! New shops will now build in 3 days.[/size][/b]

[size=4][b][b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Works with new saves and existing saves[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Only affects shops that haven't been built yet[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Safe to add mid-playthrough[/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]FAQ:[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Q: Do I need to download all 8?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]A: No! Only download the patches for the shops you actually have installed.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Q: Will this affect my already built shops?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]A: No, only shops that are still under construction.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Q: Can you make it 1 day or instant?[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]A: 3 days is balanced. Instant might break Robin's schedule. If you want 1 day, let me know![/b][/size]

[size=4][b][b]My Other Mods:[/b][/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Check my profile for all 8 custom shops and other content mods![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Enjoy and let me know if you have issues![/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth[/b][/size]
